$comment: Curated, freely licensed photographs downloaded during `npm run images:build` (the build server has internet; this list is tried only when assets/photos/<key>.jpg is absent). Candidates are tried in order; the first that downloads and passes validation is used. Pexels is listed first because its image CDN serves build servers reliably; Unsplash's download endpoint refuses non-browser clients, so Unsplash entries are kept only as a last resort. Pexels: https://www.pexels.com/license/ · Unsplash: https://unsplash.com/license
